newsitem.title: USA: Sierra Pacific files for rate adjustments.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Pacific files for rate adjustments.

text.p: Sierra Pacific Power Co. filed Wednesday with the Public Service Commission of Nevada to reduce electricity prices by $8.2 million and raise natural gas prices by $1.3 million, effective from January 1, 1997.

As an alternative to these changes, the Reno, Nev.-based utility filed a motion to adopt a rate plan previously approved by the commission in the recently terminated Sierra Pacific/Washington Water Power merger.

The utility said this settlement froze electricity and gas rates through 1999, but included a one-time $9-million refund to Nevada electricity customers, a $4-million refund to Nevada natural gas customers and a 50/50 sharing between customers and shareholders of utility earnings over 12 percent.
